# Vendored dependencies

## PixiJS

- Version: 8.21.0
- Source: https://pixijs.com/versions
- Package: pixi.js
- License: MIT
- Production browser build path: `vendor/pixi.min.js`
- Runtime policy: local only; no CDN dependency

The production browser build must be the unmodified PixiJS 8.21.0 `dist/pixi.min.js` file.
